authority: Trusted ingress binds source metadata; an independent policy authorizes reads. This infrastructure does not authenticate production owners, accept MFM interpretations, qualify model artifacts or demonstrate learned behavior.
failure_or_lesson: An observation date does not establish when evidence became available. Caller-held raw reference maps and role-flattened manifests cannot provide the registered-source recovery and lineage required by the current MFM.
goal: Connect current upstream MFM source/context interfaces to selected durable source and custody planes without substitute weights.
procedure: Preserve actual Kurrent commit time; immutably register original evidence and encrypted raw-reference metadata in XTDB; route independent query manifests to original source IDs; reuse upstream closure assembly and read receipts; revalidate permissions before persisted delivery and verify source recovery after authority service restart.
validation: 33 deterministic component methods passed against current upstream MFM contracts. New real selected-backend and authority-restart integration checks await CI.
